mcu.flash_mb_provenance: vendor_claim - 2 MB is the Pico default; other boards differ. Read it off the board.
mcu.psram_note: The RP2040 has no PSRAM interface. It has 264 KB of on-chip SRAM.

consumed.23: On the Pico: SMPS power-save control. Not broken out.
consumed.24: On the Pico: VBUS sense. Not broken out.
consumed.29: On the Pico: VSYS voltage sense via a divider, on ADC3.

pin_notes.26: ADC0. The RP2040 ADC has a documented differential-nonlinearity quirk; do not expect a clean monotonic ladder from a resistor-ladder keypad without characterising it.

notes: The RP2040 has no ADC2/Wi-Fi conflict, because it has no radio. On the Pico W the radio is a separate CYW43439 driven over its own pins.

There is no RTC-capable-pin restriction in the ESP32 sense. Low-power wake works differently; this profile deliberately leaves rtc_capable empty rather than guessing, so the linter will flag any wake source as unverified for this family.
Any GPIO can be any function via the PIO and the pin mux, which makes conflict checking MORE important, not less: nothing physically stops you double-booking a pin.
This is a generic profile. Confirm the specific board's broken-out pin set before allocating.
sources: Raspberry Pi RP2040 datasheet and Pico datasheet (general knowledge)

sources.ref: Raspberry Pi RP2040 datasheet and Raspberry Pi Pico datasheet: GPIO count, ADC channels GPIO26-28, Pico-specific GPIO23/24/25/29 usage

gpio_map.note: Pico-shaped. Other RP2040 boards expose different subsets.

corroboration.conservative_rationale: Deliberately incomplete rather than wrong. rtc_capable is left EMPTY instead of guessing, so pinmap_lint reports any wake source on this family as unverified rather than blessing it. Pico-specific pins 23/24/25/29 are marked consumed even though other RP2040 boards route them differently.

open_questions.question: Low-power wake behaviour for this family has not been characterised, which is why rtc_capable is empty.
open_questions.impact: Any deep-sleep wake design on RP2040 is flagged as unverified by pinmap_lint.
